annotations.title: Chauffeur packages — hourly blocks, day trips, ski resorts (Precellence Service)

description: Read-only catalogue of the named chauffeur packages of Precellence Service, Paris, with their prices including VAT per vehicle class, read from the tariff in force: (1) "duration": hourly hire blocks sold online (3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12 hours), with hours, km included, what is included, the overtime and extra-km prices and a booking link template (booking_url_template: the booking form with the duration and class set), and the week (6 days × 8 h, same chauffeur, on written request); (2) "destination": day trips from Paris with an agreed itinerary (Champagne / Reims, Normandy, Mont-Saint-Michel, Versailles), fixed prices, booked on written quote; (3) "season": ski-resort packages of the season (ski-2026-27: day, week and evening with the same chauffeur, resorts and season dates), booked on written quote, flagged "provisional" while the prices are provisional. Each package has an id, a category, prices_ttc per class, pricing_basis, bookable_online, a pre-filled link (booking_url_template or quote_form_url) and its validity (valid_from, tariff_version). No booking, no payment, no external service called. FR : catalogue des forfaits (blocs de mise à disposition, journées à destination, stations de ski), prix TTC par véhicule. AR : قائمة الباقات (ساعات السائق، رحلات اليوم، منتجعات التزلّج)، الأسعار شاملة الضريبة لكل سيارة. ES : catálogo de paquetes (chófer por horas, excursiones de un día, estaciones de esquí), precios con IVA por vehículo.

category.description: "duration" (hourly hire blocks and week), "destination" (day trips with an agreed itinerary) or "season" (ski-resort packages). Omitted: all packages.

lang.description: Language of names and links. One of the 7 website languages: fr, en, ar, es, tr, ru, zh. Texts exist in fr, en, ar, es; tr, ru, zh get English texts (field "lang" of the answer = language served). Names read from the tariff (classes, zones, destinations) that have no version in the language served are given in English and flagged by "name_lang". Booking link: booking form in fr, en, ar, es; English booking form for tr, ru, zh.

season.description: Ski season (category "season"); implies category "season" when category is omitted.
